userText: Find hotels near the sphere Vegas
reply:
Here are some highly rated hotels near the Sphere in Las Vegas, within easy walking distance or a short ride:

1. The Venetian Resort Las Vegas, ~8 min walk across the bridge to the Sphere. Huge suites, great dining, and direct access to the convention center. Mid range to upscale.

2. The Palazzo at The Venetian, Adjoining the Venetian, same proximity, more luxurious, quieter rooms. Also very close.

3. Treasure Island, TI Las Vegas, ~10 min walk. More affordable, solid casino resort, good value if you're looking to save.

4. The Mirage, ~12 min walk (though it's being rebranded to Hard Rock, so check status). Good mid range option with a tropical vibe.

5. Hilton Elara, ~15 min walk or quick taxi. All suite, no casino, quieter, right next to the Miracle Mile Shops.

Do you have dates in mind and a nightly budget? That way I can zero in on the best fit and check availability/prices for you.

score.why: Info is helpful despite being too formal

userText: I am thinking 50 a night send me images too
reply:
$50/night right next to the Sphere is basically impossible, that corner is all Venetian/Wynn money. Cheapest walkable options (Linq, Harrah's) start around $120+. At $50 you're looking at a short drive/Uber away, and you'll want to avoid resort fees.

Best budget bets:

1. Circus Circus, ~2.5 mi, usually $50, 70, free parking. Loud and dated, but the price is right. [Photo search](https://www.google.com/search?q=Circus+Circus+Las+Vegas+hotel+photos&tbm=isch)

2. Motel 6 Tropicana, ~2 mi, often under $60, no resort fee, bare bones but clean. Best for staying on budget. [Photo search](https://www.google.com/search?q=Motel+6+Tropicana+Las+Vegas+hotel+photos&tbm=isch)

3. Banana Bungalow Hostel, ~4 mi, dorm beds ~$30, private rooms ~$75. Good if you only need a bed. [Photo search](https://www.google.com/search?q=Banana+Bungalow+Las+Vegas+hostel+photos&tbm=isch)

I can't attach actual photos in this chat, but those links will show you plenty. Want me to check real rates? And which nights are you looking at?
